name: AnythingLLM
description: A private chat-with-your-documents application: workspaces of uploaded files, embedded into a built-in vector database and answered by the model provider you connect, local or hosted. One container; documents, embeddings and the SQLite database all live on the storage volume.

access.note: AnythingLLM starts with no password at all: whoever opens the address first can use it and change its settings. Open it yourself the moment the deployment is ready and either set an instance password or switch on multi-user mode under Settings → Security, then connect a model provider under Settings → LLM. Nothing here holds a provider's API key.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open. AnythingLLM builds no absolute URLs, so nothing else here changes when it is set.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The chat interface, the API and the embeddable widget

volumes.name: storage
volumes.purpose: Documents, vector embeddings, the SQLite database and downloaded models

update.notes: AnythingLLM migrates its database on start. The embedding model it downloads on first use is cached on the storage volume.

secrets.name: jwt-secret
secrets.label: JWT secret
secrets.description: Signs sessions once a password or multi-user mode is set; changing it signs everybody out.

secrets.name: sig-key
secrets.label: Signature key
secrets.description: Encrypts the provider keys AnythingLLM stores; changing it makes them unreadable.
